title: MCP emission ledger row
description: One line of the MCP emission ledger, mcp-emissions.jsonl in the private store directory (CW_MCP_EMISSIONS), written by recordSignals() in mcp/emission-ledger.mjs: one row per injection-shaped signal the detector in lib/untrusted-text.mjs raised over a run_checks_start job's inputs or output. A row records that a signal was seen, never a severity. It carries a hash of the matched text and never the text, which is attacker-controlled and may carry a secret. Rotated generations (mcp-emissions.jsonl.N) hold the same rows.

at.description: When the row was written, ISO 8601 (CW_NOW honoured).

jobId.description: The job the signal was raised on, as run_checks_start returned it.

tool.description: The MCP tool whose request created the job.

source.description: input: the request's string arguments. output: the run's result and the scanned tail of its log.

rule.description: The detector signal id, e.g. override-instructions.

span.description: The first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of the domain-separated matched text (spanHash). The same text gives the same span, so repeats can be counted without the text being stored.

prev.description: The chain link written by chainedAppend in bin/lib/touch-chain.mjs: the first 32 hex characters of the sha256 of the previous line, 'genesis' at the start, 'rotation:<hash>' after a rotation, or 'unlinked' when the lock could not be had in time.

rotfail.description: Present only on an unlinked row written while a rotation failed: which step, and its error code.
